label: cor:commutative-chirality-vanishes
title: Chirality term vanishes in the commutative QOU limit
html:
Corollary (of Frobenius S-classification applied in the commutative QOU limit). In the commutative specialisation q \to 1, the chirality term h_{\mathrm{A}}^2 \Phi_3 in the Wedderburn mass formula (Wedderburn mass formula) vanishes identically:

  \lim_{q \to 1} h_{\mathrm{A}}^2 \cdot \Phi_3 = 0.

Consequently the commutative atomic mass formula reduces to the two-term expression

  \mathfrak{m}^{\mathrm{class}}(Z, N) = Z\,\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{p}} + N\,\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{n}} + Z\,m_e + \alpha \bigl(\Phi_1 - 6\,\Phi_2\bigr),

where \alpha = m_e \cdot 8G and \lim_{q \to 1} [3]_q = 3.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall: it invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs — real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. Any generic categorical / q-deformation identities it draws on remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is specialised here.
